title: Fashion segmentation prediction (one image)
description: Contract between the model packaged by fashion-seg-train and its consumers (fashion-serving). A copy lives in both repositories: change them together. Adding optional fields is backward compatible; renaming or removing fields is not.

class_id.description: Model class id; 0 is the background and never returned.

box.description: [y1, x1, y2, x2] in pixels of the input image; (y2, x2) excluded.

mask_rle.description: iMaterialist RLE: space-separated 1-indexed 'start length' pairs, column-major.
